name: roi-calculator
description: Local, offline AI cost and ROI calculator for Azure and Snowflake workloads (CAD). Includes a token calculator for quick estimates.

scripts.prices: pnpm prices:azure && pnpm prices:snowflake && pnpm prices:resources
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter @roi-calculator/web build && cd apps/web && npx -y wrangler@3 pages deploy out --project-name token-calculator --branch main --commit-dirty=true
